```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, 
                      fig.width = 7)

library(here)
source(here("lib", "setup.R"))
source(here("lib", "helper_Seurat.R"))
source(here("lib", "helper.R"))
source(here("lib", "aesthetics.R"))

clust_pal_list <- readxl::read_excel(file.path(results_dir, "cluster_annotations.xlsx")) %>% 
    tidyr::fill(Subset, clustering) %>% 
    named_group_split(Subset, clustering) %>% 
    set_names(c("M", "Tdoublets", "T", "full")) %>% 
    imap(~set_names(..1$color, paste0(..1$cluster, ": ", ..1$cluster_ID)))
```

# Read in Seurat objects

```{r}
so_full <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10.rds"))
cluster_ann_df <- readxl::read_excel(file.path(results_dir, "cluster_annotations.xlsx")) %>% 
    tidyr::fill(Subset, clustering) %>% 
    filter(Subset == "so_filterRNA200mito10.rds") %>% 
    filter(clustering == "RNA_snn_res.0.5") %>% 
    mutate(cluster_ID_name = paste0(cluster, ": ", cluster_ID))
cluster_ID_grouped_key <- cluster_ann_df$cluster_ID_grouped %>% set_names(cluster_ann_df$cluster)
cell_type_metadata <- get_metadata_from_so(so_full, metadata = "RNA_snn_res.0.5", reduction = NULL) %>%
    mutate(clusters_grouped = cluster_ID_grouped_key[as.character(RNA_snn_res.0.5)]) %>% 
    select(-RNA_snn_res.0.5) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("cell")
so_full <- AddMetaData(so_full, metadata = cell_type_metadata)
```

```{r}
so_T <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetTremovedoublets.rds"))
```

```{r}
so_M <- readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "so_filterRNA200mito10_subsetMremovedoublets.rds"))
```


# Ifng expression 

```{r, fig.width = 5}
plot_ifng_violin <- function(so, group_var, fill_palette) {
    group_var <- enquo(group_var)
    get_metadata_from_so(so, genes = "Ifng") %>% 
        plot_violin(group = !!group_var, var = Ifng) + 
        scale_fill_manual(values = fill_palette) +
        labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Log normalized expr.", title = "Ifng") + 
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1))    
}
plot_ifng_violin(so_T, clusters_T, clust_pal_list$T)
plot_ifng_violin(so_M, clusters_M, clust_pal_list$M)
plot_ifng_violin(so_full, clusters, clust_pal_list$full)
```

```{r}
plot_ifng_violin(so_M, clusters_M, clust_pal_list$M) + 
    geom_jitter(width = 0.1, size = 0.2) + 
    facet_grid(group~.) + 
    theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0))
```

```{r, fig.width = 5 / 2.5, fig.asp = 1}
m_ifng_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so_M, genes = c("Ifng")) %>% 
    filter(clusters_M %>% str_detect(negate = TRUE, pattern = "DC")) %>% 
    mutate(genotype = ifelse(genotype == "Ctrl", "WT", genotype))
m_mean_ifng_df <- m_ifng_df %>% 
    group_by(mouse, group, treatment, genotype) %>% 
    summarise(mean_ifng = mean(Ifng)) 

# m_mean_ifng_df %>% 
#     ggplot() + 
#     aes(mouse, treatment) + 
#     geom_tile(aes(fill = mean_ifng)) + 
#     facet_grid(~genotype, scale = "free_x") +
#     scale_fill_viridis() + 
#     remove_x_spine() + 
#     theme(axis.line.y = element_blank(), 
#           axis.title.x = element_text(), 
#           axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
#           axis.ticks.y = element_blank()) +
#      labs(title = "Mean Ifng expression in myeloid (non-DC)")

m_mean_ifng_df %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(treatment, mean_ifng) + 
    geom_col(
        aes(y = mm_ifng, fill = genotype),
        width = 0.4,
        data = ~ ..1 %>%
            group_by(treatment, genotype) %>%
            summarise(mm_ifng = mean(mean_ifng))
    ) + 
    geom_errorbar(aes(y = NULL, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax), 
                  width = 0.25, 
                  data = ~..1 %>% 
                      group_by(treatment, genotype) %>% 
                      summarise(mm_ifng = mean(mean_ifng), 
                                se_ifng = sd(mean_ifng) / sqrt(n()), 
                                ymin = mm_ifng - se_ifng, 
                                ymax = mm_ifng + se_ifng)) + 
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("CD40 agonist", "Isotype"))) + 
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = ~c(0, ..1[2]*1.1)) + 
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2) + 
    facet_grid(~genotype) + 
    remove_x_spine() + 
    theme(legend.position = "none") + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey80", "grey40")) + 
    labs(title = "Mean Ifng expression in myeloid (non-DC)", 
         y = "Mean Ifng gene expr. ")

m_ifng_df %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(treatment, Ifng, group = mouse) + 
    geom_violin(aes(fill = genotype), 
                scale = "width", 
                position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) + 
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = ~c(0, ..1[2]*1.1)) + 
    geom_jitter(aes(color = mouse), 
                position = position_jitterdodge(seed = 1, 
                                                jitter.width = 0.1, 
                                                dodge.width = 0.9), 
                size = 0.5) +
    facet_grid(~genotype) + 
    remove_x_spine() + 
    theme(legend.position = "none") + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("grey80", "grey40")) + 
    scale_color_manual(values = c(rep("grey40", 7), rep("grey80", 9))) + 
    labs(title = "Ifng expression in myeloid (non-DC)", 
         y = "Ifng gene expr. ")
```



```{r, fig.width = 12}
count_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so_T, genes = "Ifng") %>%
    group_by(mouse, group, clusters_T) %>% 
    count() %>% 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(mouse, group), 
                names_from = clusters_T, 
                values_from = n, 
                values_fill = 0) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = 3:ncol(.), 
                 names_to = "clusters_T", 
                 values_to = "n")
mean_ifng_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so_T, genes = "Ifng") %>%
    group_by(mouse, group, clusters_T) %>%
    summarise(mean_ifng = mean(Ifng),
              pct_expr = sum(Ifng > 0) / n() * 100, 
              n = n())
count_df %>% 
    left_join(mean_ifng_df) %>% 
    replace_na(list(mean_ifng = 0, pct_expr = 0)) %>% 
    mutate(group = str_replace(group, "__", "\n")) %>% 
    ggplot() +
    aes(group, mean_ifng) +
    geom_point(aes(size = n), alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_crossbar(
        aes(
            y = mean_mean_ifng,
            ymin = mean_mean_ifng - se_ifng,
            ymax = mean_mean_ifng + se_ifng
        ),
        data = ~ ..1 %>%
            group_by(clusters_T, group) %>%
            summarise(
                mean_mean_ifng = mean(mean_ifng),
                se_ifng = sd(mean_ifng) / sqrt(n()), 
                .groups = "drop"
            ), 
        width = 0.4
    ) +
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("B2m KO\nCD40 agonist", 
                                            "B2m KO\nIsotype"), 
                                          c("Ctrl\nCD40 agonist", 
                                            "Ctrl\nIsotype"))) + 
    facet_wrap(~ clusters_T, scale = "free_y", ncol = 6) + 
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = ~c(0, ..1[2]*1.1)) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) + 
    remove_x_spine()
```

```{r ifng heatmap, fig.width = 12 , fig.asp = 1/2}
n_mtx <- get_metadata_from_so(so_T, genes = "Ifng") %>% 
    group_by(group, clusters_T) %>% 
    summarise(n = n()) %>% 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = group, 
                names_from = clusters_T, 
                values_from = n) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("group") %>% 
    as.matrix() 
get_metadata_from_so(so_T, genes = "Ifng") %>% 
    group_by(group, clusters_T) %>% 
    summarise(mean_ifng = mean(Ifng), 
              pct_expr = sum(Ifng > 0) / n() * 100) %>% 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = group, 
                names_from = clusters_T, 
                values_from = mean_ifng) %>% 
    column_to_rownames("group") %>% 
    as.matrix() %>% 
    Heatmap(
        col = viridis(100), 
        cluster_rows = FALSE, 
        name = "mean Ifng expr", 
        cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, w, h, col) {
            # add text to each grid
            grid.text(n_mtx[i, j], x, y)
        }
    )
```


```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so_T, genes = "Ifng") %>% 
    group_by(mouse, group, clusters_T) %>% 
    summarise(mean_ifng = mean(Ifng), 
              pct_expr = sum(Ifng > 0) / n() * 100) %>% 
    mutate(group = str_replace(group, "__", "\n")) %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(mouse, clusters_T, color = mean_ifng, size = pct_expr) + 
    geom_point() + 
    facet_grid(~group, scale = "free_x") +
    labs(title = "Ifng") + 
    scale_color_viridis() + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
          axis.line.x = element_blank(), 
          axis.ticks = element_blank(), 
          plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```

Okay, that's a nice summary plot which incorporates the information about each mouse. But kind of a pain to stare at tbh.

```{r}
out_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "dge_cd40-vs-isotype")
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir)
so_b2m <- subset(so_T %>% set_idents("genotype"), ident = "B2m KO")
marker_b2m_df <- run_or_readRDS(
    file.path(out_dir, "subsetTremovedoublets_markers_b2m.rds"), 
    function() {
        so_b2m@meta.data$clusters_T %>%
            unique() %>%
            set_names() %>%
            map_dfr(~ {
                FindMarkers(
                    so_b2m %>% set_idents("clusters_T"),
                    subset.ident = ..1,
                    group.by = "treatment",
                    ident.1 = "CD40 agonist"
                ) %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene")
            }, .id = "clusters_T")
    }
)

so_wt <- subset(so_T %>% set_idents("genotype"), ident = "Ctrl")
marker_wt_df <- run_or_readRDS(
    file.path(out_dir, "subsetTremovedoublets_markers_wt.rds"), 
    function() {
        so_wt@meta.data$clusters_T %>%
            unique() %>%
            set_names() %>%
            map_dfr(~ {
                FindMarkers(
                    so_wt %>% set_idents("clusters_T"),
                    subset.ident = ..1,
                    group.by = "treatment",
                    ident.1 = "CD40 agonist"
                ) %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene")
            }, .id = "clusters_T")
    }
)
```


```{r}
get_metadata_from_so(so_T, genes = c("Ifng")) %>% 
    filter(!(general_T_subtypes %in% c("gdT and ILC2", "IFN-sensing"))) %>%
    ggplot() + 
    aes(group, Ifng) + 
    geom_violin(aes(fill = group), 
                size = 0.2, 
                color = "white", 
                scale = "width", 
                draw_quantiles = c(0.5)) + 
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("Ctrl__CD40 agonist", 
                                            "Ctrl__Isotype"), 
                                          c("B2m KO__CD40 agonist", 
                                            "B2m KO__Isotype"), 
                                          c("B2m KO__Isotype", "Ctrl__Isotype")), 
                       size = 3) + 
    facet_wrap(~general_T_subtypes) + 
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = ~c(.[[1]], .[[2]]*1.3)) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), 
          axis.title.x = element_blank()) + 
    remove_x_spine() + 
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("darkblue", "blue", "grey20", "grey70"))
```

```{r, fig.width = 7}
plot_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so_T, genes = c("Ifng")) %>% 
    filter(!(general_T_subtypes %in% c("gdT and ILC2", "IFN-sensing"))) %>% 
    group_by(general_T_subtypes, mouse, group, genotype, treatment) %>% 
    summarise(mean_ifng = mean(Ifng))
dist_df <- plot_df %>% 
    group_by(group, general_T_subtypes) %>% 
    summarise(mean_mean_ifng = mean(mean_ifng), 
              se_mean_ifng = sd(mean_ifng) / sqrt(n()), 
              ymin = mean_mean_ifng - se_mean_ifng, 
              ymax = mean_mean_ifng + se_mean_ifng)
plot_df %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    aes(group, mean_ifng) + 
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, aes(color = group)) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, y = NULL),
                  data = dist_df,
                  width = 0.3) +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_mean_ifng, ymax = mean_mean_ifng, y = NULL), 
                  data = dist_df, 
                  width = 0.5) + 
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("Ctrl__CD40 agonist",
                                            "Ctrl__Isotype"),
                                          c("B2m KO__CD40 agonist",
                                            "B2m KO__Isotype"),
                                          c("B2m KO__Isotype", "Ctrl__Isotype")),
                       size = 3,
                       method = "t.test") +
    facet_wrap(~general_T_subtypes) + 
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = ~c(.[[1]], .[[2]]*1.3)) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_blank()) +
    remove_x_spine() +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("darkblue", "blue", "grey20", "grey70")) +
    labs(caption = "p-values from t-test, not FDR corrected\nBars denote mean and standard error", 
         y = "Mean Ifng expr.")
```

# Ifngr expression

```{r, fig.width = 5}
plot_ifngr_violin <- function(so, group_var, fill_palette) {
    group_var <- enquo(group_var)
    get_metadata_from_so(so, genes = c("Ifngr1", "Ifngr2")) %>% 
        pivot_longer(cols = c("Ifngr1", "Ifngr2")) %>% 
        plot_violin(group = !!group_var, var = value) + 
        facet_grid(name~.) + 
        scale_fill_manual(values = fill_palette) +
        labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Log normalized expr.", title = "Ifngr1") + 
        theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1)) 
}
plot_ifngr_violin(so_T, clusters_T, clust_pal_list$T)
plot_ifngr_violin(so_M, clusters_M, clust_pal_list$M)
plot_ifngr_violin(so_full, clusters, clust_pal_list$full)
```

```{r Ifngr1, fig.width = 8}
gene <- "Ifngr1"
count_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so_M) %>%
    group_by(mouse, group, clusters_M) %>% 
    count() %>% 
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(mouse, group), 
                names_from = clusters_M, 
                values_from = n, 
                values_fill = 0) %>% 
    pivot_longer(cols = 3:ncol(.), 
                 names_to = "clusters_M", 
                 values_to = "n")
mean_ifng_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so_M, genes = gene) %>%
    group_by(mouse, group, clusters_M) %>%
    summarise(mean_ifng = mean(Ifngr1),
              pct_expr = sum(Ifngr1 > 0) / n() * 100, 
              n = n())
count_df %>% 
    left_join(mean_ifng_df) %>% 
    replace_na(list(mean_ifng = 0, pct_expr = 0)) %>% 
    # filter(clusters_M %>% str_detect("5:|7:|9:|13:")) %>% 
    mutate(group = str_replace(group, "__", "\n")) %>% 
    ggplot() +
    aes(group, mean_ifng) +
    geom_point(aes(size = n), alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_crossbar(
        aes(
            y = mean_mean_ifng,
            ymin = mean_mean_ifng - se_ifng,
            ymax = mean_mean_ifng + se_ifng
        ),
        data = ~ ..1 %>%
            group_by(clusters_M, group) %>%
            summarise(
                mean_mean_ifng = mean(mean_ifng),
                se_ifng = sd(mean_ifng) / sqrt(n()), 
                .groups = "drop"
            ), 
        width = 0.4
    ) +
    stat_compare_means(comparisons = list(c("B2m KO\nCD40 agonist", 
                                            "B2m KO\nIsotype"), 
                                          c("Ctrl\nCD40 agonist", 
                                            "Ctrl\nIsotype"))) + 
    facet_wrap(~ clusters_M, scale = "free_y", ncol = 5) + 
    scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0, 0), limits = ~c(0, ..1[2]*1.1)) + 
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 1), 
          legend.position = "right") + 
    labs(title = gene) + 
    remove_x_spine()
```

# Ifng GSEA for all cells

```{r}
b_cells <- get_metadata_from_so(so_full, metadata = "clusters") %>%
    filter(clusters %in% c("14: B cells")) %>%
    .$cell
so_full_subset <-
    subset(so_full, cells = c(colnames(so_T), colnames(so_M), b_cells))
```

```{r}
dge_b2m_cd40.v.isotype <-
    run_or_readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "dge_b2m_cd40.v.isotype_df.rds"),
                   function() {
                       FindMarkers(
                           so_full_subset %>% set_idents("genotype"),
                           subset.ident = "B2m KO",
                           group.by = "treatment",
                           ident.1 = "CD40 agonist",
                           ident.2 = "Isotype"
                       )
                   })

dge_b2m_cd40.v.isotype_fc <-
    run_or_readRDS(file.path(results_dir, "fc_b2m_cd40.v.isotype_df.rds"),
                   function() {
                       FoldChange(
                           so_full_subset %>% set_idents("genotype"),
                           subset.ident = "B2m KO",
                           group.by = "treatment",
                           ident.1 = "CD40 agonist",
                           ident.2 = "Isotype"
                       )
                   })
```

```{r}
dge_b2m_cd40.v.isotype_df <- dge_b2m_cd40.v.isotype %>% 
    as_tibble(rownames = "gene") %>% 
    mutate(signed_p = ifelse(avg_log2FC > 0, -log10(p_val + 1e-100), log10(p_val + 1e-100))) %>% 
    arrange(desc(signed_p), desc(avg_log2FC)) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number())
```

```{r}
h_signature_path <- here("data", "signatures", "h_mouse.gmt")
ifng_response_genes <- read_tsv(h_signature_path, col_names = FALSE) %>%

    column_to_rownames("X1") %>% 
    as.vector() %>% 
    unlist() %>% 
    unname()
```

```{r}
library(liger)
gsea_out <- gsea(
    set_names(
        dge_b2m_cd40.v.isotype_fc$avg_log2FC,
        rownames(dge_b2m_cd40.v.isotype_fc)
    ),
    geneset = ifng_response_genes,
    power = 0, 
    return.details = TRUE
)
gsea_out
```

```{r}


cluster_M_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so_M, metadata = c("clusters_M"), reduction = NULL)
cluster_T_df <- get_metadata_from_so(so_T, metadata = c("clusters_T"), reduction = NULL)

plot_df <- cell_metadata_vision %>% 
    select(cell, HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE) %>% 
    left_join(cluster_M_df, by = "cell") %>% 
    left_join(cluster_T_df, by = "cell") %>% 
    mutate(subcluster = case_when(
        (!is.na(clusters_M)) ~ paste0("Myeloid (", as.character(clusters_M), ")"), 
        (!is.na(clusters_T)) ~ paste0("T/NK (", as.character(clusters_T), ")"), 
        TRUE ~ "other"
    )) 
subcluster_ordering <- plot_df %>% 
    group_by(subcluster) %>% 
    summarise(avg_ifng = median(HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE)) %>% 
    arrange(avg_ifng) %>% 
    .$subcluster
plot_df %>%
    filter(subcluster != "other") %>%
    mutate(cat = ifelse(startsWith(subcluster, "Myeloid"), "M", "T/NK")) %>%
    mutate(subcluster = factor(subcluster, levels = rev(subcluster_ordering))) %>%
    ggplot() +
    aes(subcluster, HALLMARK_INTERFERON_GAMMA_RESPONSE) +
    geom_violin(
        scale = "width",
        draw_quantiles = 0.5,
        aes(fill = cat)
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("cornsilk3", "aquamarine3")) + 
    theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(
            angle = 90,
            hjust = 1,
            vjust = 0.5
        ),
        axis.title.y = element_text(hjust = 2)
    ) +
    remove_x_spine() +
    labs(y = "Hallmark Ifng response (VISION)")
```

# Ifng-Ifngr receptor ligand analysis

Since we've already run the CellPhoneDB results, may as well see what it says. 

```{r}
cpdb_dir <- file.path(results_dir, "cpdb")
cpdb_data_dir <- file.path(cpdb_dir, "out_20221205_bymouse_ALLclusters")
cpdb_tidy_list <- readRDS(file.path(cpdb_data_dir, "cpdb_tidy_list.rds"))
```

```{r}
cpdb_ifng_df <- cpdb_tidy_list %>%
    map_dfr( ~ {
        ..1 %>%
            filter(interacting_pair %>% str_detect("IFNG"))
    }, .id = "mouse") %>% 
    mutate(mouse = str_sub(mouse, start = 5))
```

```{r}
plot_cpdb_heatmap <- function(cellcell_regex_str) {
    sig_mtx <- cpdb_ifng_df %>% 
        filter(cell_cell %>% str_detect(cellcell_regex_str)) %>% 
        mutate(padj = p.adjust(pvalue, method = "BH")) %>% 
        mutate(sig = case_when(
            padj < 0.001 ~ "***", 
            padj < 0.01 ~ "**", 
            padj < 0.05 ~ "*", 
            TRUE ~ ""
        )) %>% 
        pivot_wider(id_cols = mouse, 
                    names_from = cell_cell, 
                    values_from = sig, 
                    values_fill = "") %>% 
        column_to_rownames("mouse") %>% 
        as.matrix()
    cpdb_ifng_df %>% 
        filter(cell_cell %>% str_detect(cellcell_regex_str)) %>% 
        pivot_wider(id_cols = mouse, 
                    names_from = cell_cell, 
                    values_from = means, 
                    values_fill = 0) %>% 
        column_to_rownames("mouse") %>% 
        as.matrix() %>% 
        Heatmap(name = "cpdb mean", 
                viridis(100), 
                height = unit(2, "in"), 
                width = unit(7, "in"), 
                cluster_rows = FALSE, 
                cell_fun = function(j, i, x, y, width, height, fill) {
                    grid.text(sig_mtx[i, j], x, y, gp = gpar(fontsize = 10))
                })
}

```

```{r, fig.asp = 1, fig.width = 10}
plot_cpdb_heatmap("\\|M7")
plot_cpdb_heatmap("\\|M5")
plot_cpdb_heatmap("L6.*\\|")
plot_cpdb_heatmap("L8.*\\|")
plot_cpdb_heatmap("L13.*\\|")
```
